snippet.title: Moonfrost - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Get another look at gameplay and the world of Moonfrost in this early access launch trailer for the life sim RPG. In a world ravaged by meteor storms, begin your cosy yet epic journey as a Frost Hunter! Rebuild a shattered village whilst enjoying a life of farming, crafting and befriending charming neighbours as you uncover the dark truths behind the mysterious Second Moon. Moonfrost is out now in Early Access on PC.
